items.author: Trump
items.text: Heading back to Washington, D.C., from China. It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip. I will be giving a News Conference tomorrow at 12 P.M., the White House. Also, will be discussing the Trade Deals with Thailand, the Philippines, and others. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普表示将公布中国行成果及与泰国、菲律宾等国的贸易协议，释放中美与东南亚贸易政策信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: ‘Misanthropic and evil’: Elon Musk’s SpaceX may get up to $120.5 billion from Anthropic, the AI lab he once slammed
items.summary_cn: 媒体称SpaceX可能从Anthropic获得最高1205亿美元收入，若落地将扩大马斯克体系在AI与航天领域的商业联系。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What the Blue Wave in Texas Means for Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX
items.summary_cn: 媒体称美国中期选举结果可能改变特斯拉与SpaceX面临的政治及监管环境，但未给出具体政策动作。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Factories Are Coming Home, ISM Just Confirmed It: https://www.realclearmarkets.com/articles/2026/11/02/the_factories_are_coming_home_ism_just_confirmed_it_1214700.html
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称制造业回流正获ISM数据确认，指向关税和供应链调整对工业生产的潜在影响。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of “Energy.” President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称已与菲律宾达成新贸易协议，并将涉及农民和能源行业，显示东南亚贸易谈判取得进展。

items.author: Trump
items.text: There has been no greater President that stands with American Farmers and Ranchers than President Donald J. Trump!As l've stated before, I was the last President to get a Farm Bill done in 2018. IT IS TIME TO DO IT AGAIN, and FAST. Our Great Farmers and Ranchers NEED and DESERVE certainty ahead of the 2027 planting season because FOOD SECURITY IS NATIONAL SECURITY!Congressional Republican Majorities, YOU MUST PASS A NEW FARM BILL DURING THE REMAINING DAYS OF CONGRESS. FARMERS AND RANCHERS ARE NOT INTERESTED IN FURTHER DELAYS. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRU
items.summary_cn: 特朗普敦促国会尽快通过新农业法案，强调农民确定性和粮食安全，政策落地或影响农产品及农业股。
